summary: The main article describes a metallaphotoredox-catalyzed stereodivergent 1,2-carboallylation of terminal alkynes using nickel and 4CzIPN. It includes one optimization table and two schemes detailing the substrate scope for (1E,4Z) and (Z,Z)-1,4-dienes, along with mechanistic studies.

items.heading: Fig. 1
items.caption: Divergent three-component carboallylation of alkynes via metallaphotoredox catalysis.
items.description: Comparison between traditional nickel-catalyzed carboallylation and the newly developed metallaphotoredox strategy for stereodivergent synthesis.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Optimization of reaction conditions a
items.description: Screening of photocatalysts, additives (pyrene), and control experiments to optimize yield and E/Z selectivity for product 4a.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Substrate scope for (1 E , 4Z )-1,4-dienes.
items.description: Exploration of the reaction scope for trans-selective skipped dienes using pyrene as a triplet energy modulator.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Substrate scope of ( Z , Z )-1,4-dienes.
items.description: Substrate scope for cis-selective skipped dienes obtained by removing the pyrene additive from the reaction conditions.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Mechanistic studies.
items.description: Various experiments including radical inhibition, radical probes, and E-to-Z isomerization controls to elucidate the reaction mechanism.

items.heading: Fig. 2
items.caption: Proposed mechanism.
items.description: A detailed catalytic cycle showing the synergistic interaction between the photocatalyst and the nickel catalyst.
